title: 3065. Minimum Operations to Exceed Threshold Value I

examples.explanation: After one operation, nums becomes equal to [2, 11, 10, 3]. After two operations, nums becomes equal to [11, 10, 3]. After three operations, nums becomes equal to [11, 10]. At this stage, all the elements of nums are greater than or equal to 10 so we can stop. It can be shown that 3 is the minimum number of operations needed so that all elements of the array are greater than or equal to 10.
All elements of the array are greater than or equal to 1 so we do not need to apply any operations on nums.
only a single element of nums is greater than or equal to 9 so we need to apply the operations 4 times on nums.
